blocks.text: CEBU CITY — What began as a petty convenience store altercation spiraled into a calculated execution and a clandestine burial. This was how police summed up the killing of 23-year-old Isaac Viernes as authorities prepare to file murder charges today, October 27, against 10 suspects linked to the crime. The gruesome details surrounding the case came to light through chilling extrajudicial confessions that exposed a web of local complicity ranging from hired accomplices and an involved mother to a mastermind currently evading capture.
